say:4:1310108001:0.text: Woah, was there an avalanche here? Are you all alright?
say:4:1310108001:0.source_cn: 咦，这里发生了雪崩？你们怎么样，没有受伤吧？

say:5:1310108002:0.text: We're fine, but our cart is broken, and the road is blocked. We won't make it to Cedartown before nightfall.
say:5:1310108002:0.source_cn: 我们还好。可车坏了，路也堵了……唉，怕是没法在天黑前赶...

say:6:1310108003:0.text: Maybe we should turn back? Forget about the festival...
say:6:1310108003:0.source_cn: 要不……咱们回去吧？不去参加那什么祭典了……

say:9:1310108004:0.text: No way! I've been waiting for this forever! I really wanna go!!
say:9:1310108004:0.source_cn: 不嘛！我想去玩，都盼了一整年了，我就要去！

say:13:1310108006:0.text: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...
say:13:1310108006:0.source_cn: 我知道这附近有条小道可以绕过这段路，路尽头还有座猎人小...
say:13:1310108006:0.male: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...
say:13:1310108006:0.female: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...

choice_prompt:14:1310108006.text: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...
choice_prompt:14:1310108006.source_cn: 我知道这附近有条小道可以绕过这段路，路尽头还有座猎人小屋可以歇歇脚……
choice_prompt:14:1310108006.male: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...
choice_prompt:14:1310108006.female: I know a small path nearby that bypasses this section, and there's a hunter's cabin at the end where we can rest...

say:15:1310108007:0.text: Well, the road's quite steep. We'll have to climb some cliffs, and there's a chance of running into wild animals.
say:15:1310108007:0.source_cn: 但……那条路很陡，要攀爬山崖，还有可能碰到野兽。
say:15:1310108007:0.male: Well, the road's quite steep. We'll have to climb some cliffs, and there's a chance of running into wild animals.
say:15:1310108007:0.female: Well, the road's quite steep. We'll have to climb some cliffs, and there's a chance of running into wild animals.

say:16:1310108008:0.source_cn: 还有野兽？听起来有点危险……

say:17:1310108009:0.text: But darling, Romain's been so excited about the festival. With this many people with us, maybe we'll be okay...
say:17:1310108009:0.source_cn: 可是亲爱的，小罗曼很想去祭典，有这么多人一起，或许咱们...

say:20:1310108010:0.text: Dangerous? Ha, the only ones in danger will be the wild animals!
say:20:1310108010:0.source_cn: 危险？嘿，有我们几个在，危险的应该是那些野兽才对。

say:22:1310108011:0.text: These people saved me from a wild animal. Sir, I promise you, the dwarf isn't exaggerating one bit.
say:22:1310108011:0.source_cn: 他们从野兽手里救了我，我保证，矮人大师这句话没有一点儿...

say:23:1310108012:0.text: Alright, let's take the small path. I hope we make it safely. Where is it?
say:23:1310108012:0.source_cn: 既然这样，那……咱们就走小路吧，希望路上平安，能早点到...

say:24:1310108013:0.text: I remember it being nearby. Let me check... hmm, strange...
say:24:1310108013:0.source_cn: 我记得就在附近……让我找找，唔，应该是这里啊，奇怪……

say:25:1310108014:0.text: Ah, there it is! But the entrance is blocked by rocks from the avalanche...
say:25:1310108014:0.source_cn: 啊，在那边，不过入口被雪崩落石堵住了……

say:31:1310108015:0.text: So we just need to <style="highlight">clear the rocks</style>! Don't underestimate Chippy's size! Sir Chippy will clear out these rocks for you!!

say:33:1310108016:0.text: With those itty-bitty muscles...? Looks like we won't reach Cedartown any time soon... But hey, as long as we roll in before the festival kicks off, we're good!
say:33:1310108016:0.source_cn: 看来没法提前到雪松镇了。唉，算了，只要能赶在祭典开始前...
